index_method: In each route, direction and hour, add the passengers above the seats and the seats above the passengers over its trips. The gap score is 0.1 when all of that is empty seats and 10 when all of it is passengers without a seat. Loads are the day's own, made from taps (forecast_peak_load holds the same measured number as peak_load until a forecast of load exists); 15 in 100 boardings had no recorded alighting and were spread along the trip. Seats are counted, not standing room.
index_note: Gap score: from 0.1 (only empty seats) to 10 (only passengers without a seat).

totals.assumption: the vehicle swaps in the right-bus decision are made; the same passengers travel at the same times. A stretch between stops is measured as a straight line, so empty seat-kilometres are an under-count.
